name: What is the typical timeline for constructing a luxury townhome with Opus Builders?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for constructing a luxury townhome with Opus Builders?

acceptedAnswer.text: The construction timeline for a luxury townhome with Opus Builders generally ranges from 12 to 18 months, depending on the complexity of the design, chosen finishes, and site-specific conditions. This includes phases such as architectural design, permitting, site preparation, foundation, framing, utility installation, interior finishing, and final landscaping. Our team provides a detailed project schedule at the outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury townhome construction typically takes 12-18 months, influenced by design complexity, finishes, and site conditions.
